grammar_focus: 将来进行时(主考:will/shall be + V-ing · 现在进行 vs 将来进行 · 各人称 · 疑问Will you be doing…? · ≈一般将来时 · 表安排好的将来)+ by+交通工具(辅考)+ 现在进行时复习对照(辅考)
scene: 流行歌手团明天乘火车到镇上 · 粉丝去车站接、晚上俱乐部演出、待五天 · 警察照例忙着维持秩序

grammar_card.title: 说"将来某时正在做什么"(将来进行时)
grammar_card.intro: 本课讲怎么说"将来某个时候正在做某事"——将来进行时。全用本课句子举例。

rows: 将来进行时 = will/shall be + 动词-ing(将来某时正在进行)
They will be arriving tomorrow.(明天将要到达)
现在'正在'用 am/is/are + doing;将来'正在'用 will be + doing
现在:They are playing. 明天:They will be playing tomorrow.
各人称都用 will be(第一人称也可用 shall be);口语 'll be
I'll be seeing you. / He'll be coming by train.
疑问:把 will 提前(Will you be doing…?);否定:won't be + doing
Will you be washing your car tomorrow?
将来进行时和一般将来时常可互换,都表将来
He'll arrive soon. = He'll be arriving soon.

specialRules.rule: 将来进行时常表示'已经安排好的、最近就要发生'的事(will be arriving = 快到了)
乘坐交通工具用 by:by train / by air / by sea / by bus(名词前不加 the/a)

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Why will the police have a difficult time?
options: Huge crowds of fans will gather for the band

passage: The Silver Hawks are a group of pop singers. At present, they are traveling all across the country. They will be arriving in our town tomorrow. They will be coming by train, and most of the young fans will be meeting them at the station. Tomorrow evening, they will be singing downtown at the Community Club. The Silver Hawks will be staying for five days, and they will give five performances. Hundreds of fans will be lining up outside the club for hours. As usual, the police will have a difficult time. They will be trying hard to keep order. It is always the same on these big occasions. What will you be doing when the Silver Hawks arrive?

grammar_points.name: 将来进行时——构成 will/shall be + V-ing
将来进行时——现在进行 vs 将来进行(now vs tomorrow)

将来进行时——疑问 Will you be doing…? / 否定 won't be
将来进行时——≈ 一般将来时(同义可换)

by + 交通工具(by train/air/sea)——辅考语言点
